en.headline: Police charge man, 52, over alleged seditious online posts
en.dek: National security officers said the Eastern District arrest was in July, with a charge laid on Wednesday at West Kowloon Court.
body: National security police said on Friday that a 52-year-old man has been charged with knowingly publishing seditious material, after an arrest in the Eastern District on 9 July.

The force said officers of the National Security Department laid the charge on the morning of 7 October under the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance. The case was mentioned that afternoon at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts. Police did not name the defendant.

Investigators said the man was suspected of repeatedly posting messages on social platforms. Police said the alleged content included inciting hatred against the country, the Hong Kong government and the judiciary, and inciting others to try to change matters established by law in the city other than by lawful means.

Police reminded the public that knowingly publishing seditious material is a serious offence, and that a first conviction can bring up to seven years in prison. The man has been charged. He has not been convicted.

zh.headline: 國安處控52歲男子涉發布具煽動意圖刊物
zh.dek: 警方稱男子7月9日在東區被捕，10月7日被控一項罪名，同日下午在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
body: 警務處國家安全處周五表示，一名52歲本地男子已被控一項「明知而發布具煽動意圖的刊物」罪。警方稱，有關執法行動於7月9日在東區進行。
國安處表示，控罪於10月7日上午正式提出，涉嫌違反《維護國家安全條例》。案件同日下午已在西九龍裁判法院提堂。警方沒有公布被告姓名。
警方調查稱，該名男子涉嫌多次在網上社交平台發布具煽動意圖的信息，內容包括引起他人對國家、香港特區政府及司法機構的憎恨，以及煽惑他人企圖不循合法途徑改變特區依法制定的事項。
警方提醒，「明知而發布具煽動意圖的刊物」屬嚴重罪行，首次定罪可被判監禁七年。該名男子已被落案起訴，尚未被法庭定罪。
